messages:
Maya: quick sync — we need a rollout plan for the blue/green stripe we're shipping for model-tier routing in EU + APAC. main goals: avoid tenant drift (some tenants staying on old route), keep latency within SLO, and have an automated rollback path. :eyes:
Alex: ok. thinking staged blue/green by region, with tenant affinity TTL so sticky sessions expire after N requests to avoid drift. start with 1% traffic in each region then 5%/20%/50%.
Rui: note on SRE side — affinity TTL alone won't help if we change model variant ids. we need a migration job or a prefix-cache invalidation. otherwise old KV entries beat the new path.
Sophia: for the model side, we'll be switching to a quantized variant for the green pool for cost tests. we need an A/B quality check set against baseline evals before moving past 5%. definition: "quality delta" <= 0.8% allowed on defined prompt set.
Oliver: CS asks for an opt-in for affected enterprise tenants and a notification template. also a quick revert plan for any customer-reported regressions.
Alex: proposed rollout gates:
- gate 1: perf smoke (p50/p95 within 10% of baseline)
- gate 2: error budget check (<0.1% increase in 15m window)
- gate 3: quality delta on eval set (<0.8% impact)
- gate 4: customer opt-in confirmations for top 10 tenants
Rui: add automated circuit breaker if p95 latency > target for 3 consecutive windows (5m each). fallback -> blue pool.
Sophia: we should shadow green traffic to blue's metrics for comparison during 1%/5% slices. runs locally so we can compute diff without impacting customers.
Maya: love the shadow idea. also need feature-flag dependency map. we have flags: `model_variant`, `quantize_toggle`, `stripe_active`, `tenant_opt_in`. they must be evaluated in the right order.
Alex: sample flag config (WIP):
```
- stripe_active: boolean
- model_variant: enum [v1, v1-quant, v2]
- tenant_opt_in: list of tenant ids
- affinity_ttl_seconds: 3600
```
Make sure `tenant_opt_in` overrides global stripe for safety.
Rui: ops checklist for rollout ops team:
- preflight: ensure redis KV TTL policy applied across regions
- canary: enable stripe_active + model_variant=green for 1%
- telemetry: enable extra traces + tokenized cost counters
- run health job to detect hidden drift (per-tenant distribution changes)
Sophia: and an eval automation job that runs nightly against fresh sample prompts and posts a summary to the rollout thread. if quality regresses, we block further slices.
Oliver: draft customer comms: short explanation, thank you, how to opt-out, expected impact. I'd like an abbreviated FAQ for support.
Maya: launch criteria summary (for PM sign-off):
- infra: rollback path tested end-to-end
- telemetry: eval job reporting + alerting wired up
- SLOs: p50/p95 and error budget gates passing on canary for 24h
- customers: top-10 informed and opt-in collected or explicit exemptions noted
- docs: runbook + support FAQ ready
Alex: scope negotiation: to hit the window we should decouple `tenant_opt_in` UI from rollout itself — opt-ins can be managed via a CSV upload for this launch, UI is a later follow-up. keeps scope minimal.
Rui: agree. also we need a fast revert toggle in the control plane that can be hit by SRE and PMs (2-person approval).
Maya: decision: go with CSV opt-in for launch, UI backlog item. implement affinity TTL + migration job for sticky sessions, and run nightly evals.
Sophia: scheduling note: we'll need 48h of shadowing at 5% and at least 12h at 20% before 50%.
Alex: I'll draft the rollout playbook and flag snippets. will post the PR with the `stripe_active` feature flag and staged traffic policy.
DeployBot: deploy scheduled: rollout/blue-green-stripe -> canary window 2026-05-02T02:00Z (estimated) :rocket:
Oliver: tagging support and account managers now for comms: @support-team @account-success
Maya: thanks everyone. next check-in tomorrow 09:30 PT. if anything blocks, drop notes here and ping me. :thumbsup:
